notes.title: Sim Racing Telemetry - v1.16.2 hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello racers! v1.16.2 is now available with the following bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a possible crash when opening Lap details while in Trial Mode.
[*] Fixed sorting of games by most recent session date.
[*] Fixed chart labels being drawn outside the chart area.
[*] Fixed incorrect formatting in some dialogs.
[/list]

Thank you very much for your reports! If you find other errors, please contact us.

notes.title: Sim Racing Telemetry v1.16.1 hotfix
notes.notes:
Hello racers! v1.16.1 is now available, containing a few bug fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed wrong slider range in session-charts page when interacting with the positions chart.
[*] Fixed desync of positions charts when zoom-in.
[*] Fixed slider range not updated when zoom-in/out.
[*] Fixed "NaN" labels on y-axis when there are not valid samples on the chart (e.g time chart).
[*] Fixed not working zoom-in/out buttons.
[/list]

Thank you for your feedback and continued support!

notes.title: Version 1.7.0
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

The new [b]version 1.7.0[/b] is out now! Here the main new features:

- [b]F1 2021[/b] - Added native support for [i]F1 2021[/i] (by Codemasters). Press the "Help" button in the recording screen of SRT for the detailed instructions, or read them directly here here: [url=https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12021/]https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12021/[/url] .

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/0b889c7f0480923506f5608a95a3010f242d33a0.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/d150d01736ec0296a8af41afa52b95bd20cf418f.jpg[/img][/url]

- [b]Color palette[/b] - Thanks to your feedbacks, we fixed a bug causing too dark colors in some charts. But as we were not satisfied enough, you can now customize the "[i]color palette[/i]" used by SRT to better suit your preferences. You can find the option in the "[i]Settings[/i]" menu.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/46d4dc510235d9e8b7c6e5c07692bd8670ec5648.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/114b6c19e7dca2c9603f86866c30398a03584c56.png[/img][/url]

- [b]Recording settings[/b] - You can now customize the available recording settings for each game. You can access the options from both the "[i]Settings[/i]" menu and the "[i]Recording[/i]" page. Options include - for example - the "[i]UDP listening port[/i]" for F1* games, simplifying how to use SRT with other tools at the same time.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/fb2fb7ea526da7381522c5272a43f1acc45fb003.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32708130/29615339b4b61dc9d7635bd87f594f9fc1c883a2.png[/img][/url]

[b]v1.7.0 is available on all the supported platforms[/b]: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/845210/Sim_Racing_Telemetry/]PC[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/845210/Sim_Racing_Telemetry/]macOS[/url], [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/sim-racing-telemetry/id1288695792?ls=1&mt=8]iOS[/url], [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.unamedia.srt]Android[/url].

We hope you'll enjoy the new features. Happy racing!

notes.title: Version 1.6.1
notes.notes:
Hi!

[h1]v1.6.1[/h1]
Thanks to your reports we fixed a possible issue on Windows: when the path or filename involved with an import/export operation contains not-latin characters, the operation can fail. Ensure to update to Version 1.6.1 and you will be able to import/export without restrictions. ハッピーレース。ːsteamhappyː

[h1]v1.6.0[/h1]
In case you lost the announcement for the new [b]version 1.6.0[/b], here the new features:
[list]
[*] [b]F1 2020[/b] - native support for [i]F1 2020[/i] (by Codemasters). Instructions on how to configure SRT and F1 2020 can be found here: [url=https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12020/]https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/help/F12020/[/url].
[*] [b]Sharing[/b] - you can now [i][b]share[/b][/i] your telemetries with other users and compare your laps with the ones from your friends. Used with the "[i]comparison[/i]" feature, this is the best tool to improve your skills. Sharing and importing is simple: open a telemetry session and press the "[i]Share[/i]" icon, select the "[i]Share[/i]" option and send/save the file. When you receive a "[i].SRT[/i]" file, you can import it from the game screen pressing the "[i]Import[/i]" icon.
[*] [b]Exporting[/b] - a long-awaited feature is finally available: you can now [i][b]export[/b][/i] your telemetry data to [i]CSV file[/i], to analyze them with other programs (Excel, LibreOffice, etc.). Exporting data is simple: open a telemetry session and press the "[i]Share[/i]" icon, select the "[i]Export to CSV[/i]" option and send/save the file. Saving CSV files could require few minutes and could result in big files, so be patient when exporting them.
[/list]

v1.6.0 is available on all the supported platforms, see our [url=https://www.simracingtelemetry.com/]web site[/url] for the download links.

We hope you'll enjoy the new features. Happy racing!

notes.title: Version 1.3 adds official support for MotoGP 18
notes.notes:
We are very happy to announce the official support for [url=https://motogpvideogame.com/]MotoGP™18[/url] in SRT! Thanks to the collaboration with Milestone, you can now analyze the telemetry of the official MotoGP™ videogame and prepare for their upcoming [url=https://esport.motogp.com/]eSport Championship[/url].

The integration with MotoGP™18 is supported on the following platforms: PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One. Telemetry is streamed only during the offline sessions.

We are already working on new integrations, that we hope to share soon with you! In the mean time, we are also rewriting some internals of SRT to support more advanced UIs and we are also developing some new views to simplify the analysis of the racing sessions.

#happyracing

notes.title: Sim Racing Telemetry will release on June 13th
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce that [i]Sim Racing Telemetry[/i] will be available to download on [b]Wednesday June 13th[/b].

Sim Racing Telemetry is the essential tool for the sim racing eSports community to quickly acquire, analyze and review detailed telemetry data from sim racing games. Sim Racing Telemetry records all available telemetry data during timed laps and presents them on simple and intuitive interfaces: drivers can analyze data by looking at bare numbers, interactive charts or projected on a reconstructed track.

The supported games at launch are: Project Cars 2, F1 2017, Project Cars, F1 2016. They are supported on both PC and consoles (PS4 and Xbox One).

SRT will be released as [i]Early Access[/i] because the current application UI is the port of the mobile version, but for desktop users we want a more professional experience with a more advanced UI. Despite this, the Early Access version will allow everyone to have access now to telemetry data.

During the Early Access, new features and integrations will be added, with some exclusive coming in the next weeks.
